test_item:
DebugAuth shall reject and delete stored AuthData when verification of AuthData which located on secure non-volatile memory failed
(verification of the stored AuthData fails; the stored AuthData is deleted)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
proc:
1. Record the content of /data/vendor/dauth on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth
2. <DUT-side trigger for SAM AuthData stored package that fails verification provided by RD (X-g)>
$ <command provided by RD (X-g)>
3. Confirm the content of /data/vendor/dauth on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth
er:
1. The adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth output lists the stored AuthData
2. <observable outcome provided by RD (X-g)>
3. The adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth output lists no stored AuthData
